text:
Ana M.: hey team — StratusKite confirmed marketplace listing + joint webinar. want to lock the execution plan this week. timeline: listing live 3/31, webinar 4/12, benchmark blog week of 4/20. thoughts on messaging and routing?
Mike P.: big +1. need two narrative hooks: 1) speed/cost story for infra teams, 2) developer DX for app teams. recommend separate CTAs.
Devon (Partnerships): StratusKite legal signed off on co-branding. they want a 30-min technical demo + 15-min customer panel for the webinar. they also asked we route inbound leads to their sales + our AE queue.
Claire G.: for inbound routing — propose: webinar registrants -> lead form w/ org size + use case -> auto-split: >100 employees -> SDR nurture (StratusKite + Redwood SDR), <100 -> product-led cadences (email drip + self-serve). SamBot can push SFDC owner assignment if we provide queue mapping.
Evan @StratusKite: confirmed. we can accept a shared lead webhook and will route to our reps for >200 seat opps. also can co-sponsor paid socials.
Ana M.: ok. action items I see: 1) finalize webinar agenda & panelists by Friday (Devon/Evan), 2) draft two headline variations for landing page and blog (Mike), 3) lead routing rules + webhook spec (Claire + Eng), 4) benchmark test plan & dataset (we'll run latency + cost vs baseline) (PM/Eng).
Mike P.: for headlines — rough: A) "Ship LLM features 3x faster with predictable inference costs" B) "Run large models at production scale — without the ops burden". will iterate.
Devon (Partnerships): panel ask: one StratusKite infra lead, one Redwood customer (maybe BeaconAI), and our infra PM. I'll confirm names.
Claire G.: routing spec — draft below, open to tweaks:
```
- event: webinar_reg
- fields: name,email,company,employees,primary_use_case,interested_in
- rule: employees >= 100 -> post to webhook /partners/stratuskite/leads + assign SFDC queue "SK Enterprise"
- rule: employees < 100 -> create lead in SFDC queue "PLG nurture"
- add tag: "stratuskite_co-marketing_0412"
```
SamBot: noted. need webhook url + auth header from StratusKite to enable forwarding.
Ana M.: benchmarks — what metrics do we want in the blog? latency p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens, throughput under burst, sample prompt categories. also include short methodology note so it's reproducible.
Mike P.: agree. also want one short repeatable prompt battery: chat assist, completion, and embedding similarity. will prep sample prompts.
Devon (Partnerships): sponsor budget — StratusKite can contribute $6k for paid socials and paid ad creative. propose split creative tasks: Redwood handles landing + blog copy, StratusKite handles ad creative variations.
Claire G.: timeline check: landing + registration live by 3/27 to give 2 weeks lead gen before webinar. webinar dry run 4/10. benchmarks complete 4/18 to give time for blog edits.
Ana M.: assigning owners: Mike -> landing + blog copy drafts; Claire -> lead routing + promo plan; Devon -> partner coordination + panel confirmations; Eng (cc @mike-eng) -> webhook + benchmark infra. I'll compile a brief PRD and share.
Evan @StratusKite: can we get a co-branded hero asset? i'll ask design and loop them in.
Mike P.: quick A/B test idea for email subject lines: A) "See how teams cut inference costs 2x" vs B) "Webinar: production LLMs without the ops tax". we'll run 50/50 for first blast.
Ana M.: perfect. Claire — can you set up the 50/50 test in the ESP and wire up utm params for source attribution?
Claire G.: yes. I'll set up tags: utm_source=stratuskite, utm_campaign=stratus_webinar_apr12, and track registrant origin.
SamBot: reminder — update the partnership tracker doc: https://redwoodhq.slack/partnerships/stratuskite (I can auto-post the final assets there).
Ana M.: OK team — let's hit these mini-deadlines: draft landing copy by Tue EOD, routing spec live Wed, webinar agenda final Fri. will follow up with a short sync Thurs at 10am. :rocket: 
Mike P.: thanks — sending draft by Tue.
Devon (Partnerships): I'll lock panel names by Friday.
Claire G.: routing spec will be in the tracker tomorrow.
Evan @StratusKite: excited — will push creative and webhook details on Monday.
Ana M.: thanks everyone. short sync Thurs 10am — invite to follow. :+1:
